objectives: Listening / Speaking / ViewingListens to nursery rhymes or poems read by the teacher and responds with appropriate sounds, words, and motions.
Describes illustrations using vocabulary appropriate for grade level.
Asks and answers questions to demonstrate comprehension of reading materials that have been presented orally.
Reading / LiteratureRhymes word patterns in poems.
Matches same initial word sounds with written word symbols.
Recognizes and names upper and lower case letters of the alphabet.
Identifies and decodes words with the syllable pattern  “cv” ba, be, bi, bo, bu  through illustrations.
Asks and answers teacher-directed questions to demonstrate comprehension of literary selection.
Writing / Language MechanicsModels and forms lower and upper case letter of the alphabet.
Forms new words using single or syllables combinations  ba, be, bi, bo, bu.
Arranges and spaces words when forming sentences.
Uses appropriate capitalization / lower case lettering conventions when writting simple sentences or proper nouns.
CultureUses simple vocabulary and short phrases in Spanish.
